operation_edge.reason:
The UPGRADE compares mavlink 2025.9.9 against 2025.12.12 for mavros 2.13.0. Its handler actually names the old qualified C++ message type, which the per-XML generator no longer supplies in the common namespace. This is a compile-time declaration dependency, not an assumed runtime topic edge.
